subject: Literature
title: Dave Eggers's The Circle
description: A 60-second lesson on Dave Eggers's The Circle.

hook.text: The Circle imagines a tech company that achieves total transparency, and the result is not freedom but total control.

buildup.text: Eggers created a fictional tech giant that combines social media, surveillance, and identity into one mandatory platform.

discovery.text: The company's slogan, 'Secrets are lies,' turns privacy into a moral failing and surveillance into a civic virtue.

twist.text: Critics noted that real tech companies had already implemented many of the novel's most extreme fictional scenarios.

climax.text: The Circle warns that the greatest threat to freedom may come not from governments but from companies we voluntarily join.

punchline.text: We signed up for surveillance and called it connection.

quiz.question: What does The Circle's company turn into a moral failing?
